selection.basis: Q00018/C120 landed immediately before commit and was re-read. It accepted B00129/B00133 only as PREFLIGHT_ONLY, produced no candidate bytes, and explicitly preserved B00134 pending its own C batch. Shared next_actions contain no B-even RENDER_READY or ONE_STAGE_TO_RENDER item. Existing candidate backlog remains runtime/dependency/revalidation work. These four C112-accepted pre-generation assets still lack current canonical user-HD source identity gates under the active source policy, so one fallback-4 preflight batch is legal and materially advances them.

notes: Q00018/C120 changed shared state but did not create any Korean candidate or B-even ready-tier classification.
B00134 is newer disjoint producer evidence awaiting C and its assets are excluded.
Selected indices 34/44/52/172 are unchanged pending_artwork/transcribed_reviewed rows whose older C112 PASS covered Release-derived pre-generation arithmetic only.
Current canonical queue paths for all four selected assets are absent from Git HEAD.

canonical_source_policy.release_identity_role: historical reconstruction prior only unless exact canonical SHA-256 equality is proven

material_advance.description: Reclassifies C112's Release-derived work-order geometry as conditional prior and pins exact current canonical user-HD identities, making exact source import/hash verification the next legal pixel-stage action for four B-even assets.

inherited_evidence.preserved_scope: Current semantic identities and C112-accepted arithmetic/guard structure only; Release pixels are conditional reconstruction prior, not canonical construction authority.

canonical_reacquisition_gate: Acquire/import the exact canonical user-HD DDS matching canonical_sha256.
Verify SHA-256 equality before any header, orientation, region or mask interpretation; filename suffix and canvas similarity are not source identity proof.
Decode the exact canonical source and record actual DDS dimensions, pixel/compression format, alpha/transparency and mip behavior.
Re-establish raw/readable orientation and semantic-to-region binding from canonical pixels; prior Release transforms/coordinates are conditional evidence only.
Measure effect-inclusive source text bboxes and construct removal/protected-art masks only from canonical pixels.
Create CLEAN_PLATE and independently require zero changes outside the removal mask, zero protected-art changes, zero alpha changes outside the mask, and no residue/seams/boxes.
Derive first-pass-v2 candidate_safe_bbox using the required inset from measured canonical geometry.
Measure typography/baseline/slant and render Korean at native canonical resolution; refit via fresh render rather than flattened resampling.
Run decoded-final DDS/header/alpha/orientation, zero-pixel containment, and exact-crop ENGLISH SOURCE vs KOREAN CANDIDATE QA.
Keep runtime_validation UNTESTED until real in-game evidence exists.

protected_artwork: rank digits/ordinals not selected for localization
